about: The single store of part knowledge behind the part card. A definition says what a kind of part is and what a learner may read about it; an instance maps one model's part id to a definition; systems are the flat list a learner filters by. See docs/part-store.md.

rules.title: The part noun from the IO-520 parts catalogue description in plain, natural order, four words at most; size, thread and length go in 'catalogue'. Where the IO-520 catalogue has no row, the GTSIO-520 overhaul manual figure key supplies the name by the same rule.

statuses.derived: worked out from a source by a stated step
statuses.inferred: a reasonable basis, not a source: the claim is not stated in any source read
statuses.illustrative: a prompt for the learner; it claims nothing about the engine

rules.numbers: Numbers appear only where a lesson or a manual gives them. Part numbers are never shown to learners.
rules.catalogueNote: IO-520 sizes and descriptions are tagged 'the GTSIO-520-H may differ' unless the GTSIO manual confirms them.
